contexts.text: That the Nephilim were called strong men from the love of self. Illustrated.
Their strength hath failed ().
The strong are here described by another word.
In the day of thy strength () = His victories in temptations.
The more (in a Society) there are... the stronger is the correspondence, because the perfection and strength are from the unanimous multitude of many... Hence results... a stronger conatus...
A lion = the truth of the Church, from its strength.
See Mighty.
The voice of the trumpet... strengthening itself exceedingly () = ... its increase. Explained.
Such are in a stronger Persuasive...
Because they reason sharply they are called the congregation of the strong ().
Jehovah strong and a hero of war (). Explained. DLord 14:9.
Their strong ones () = the Hells.

A strong Angel preaching with a great voice () = Divine truth from the Lord inflowing deeply into the thought... He is called a strong Angel, because it is preached with power; and that which is preached with power inflows deeply into the thought.
The strong () = those in erudition from doctrine from the Word; abstractedly, the erudition thence.
The male has a stronger body.
Who loves a general... except for his bravery...
His fear of losing the name of bravery.

It appears as if (evil Spirits) had great power, and therefore they are called the powerful, the mighty, the strong, heroes; but their power lies in the falsities of others, by means of innumerable arts, and also by simulations of truth... AE 776:end. AE 783:3.
See Horn.
The strong one () = the truth from good which destroys evil.
Strong ones () = natural truths.
The Strong in heart () = those in truths from good.
Strong ones () = falsities and reasonings from them.
He that is strong in heart () = he that trusts in his falsities. AE 357:22.
The strong one of Jacob = the Lord. (So called from the Divine in ultimates, in which Divine power is in its fulness. AE 684:26.)
The bow of the strong ones () = the doctrine of truth from the Knowledges which prevail against falsities.
The hand of him that is stronger than he () = the evil and falsity which previously had possession.
To remove the strong one and the man of war () = to remove all resistance to evils and falsities. AE 727:12, Explained.
A strong Angel () = the Lord as to the Word.
All strength and power are in the ultimates of Divine truth, thus in the natural sense of the Word, which is the sense of the letter... This is why the Angel... is called strong.
The strong ones, that is, the oxen () = the affections of good. ( = the affections of the natural man. AE 650:47.)
The strong one and the man of war () = good and truth (or the truth of good) fighting with evil and falsity and destroying them. AE 650:48.
As these scientifics, being from the fallacies of the senses, persuade strongly, they are called the congregation of the strong ones () AE 654:54.
The strong one of the nations () = the falsity of evil.
The ark of Thy strength () = the Divine truth proceeding from Him; for through this the Lord has Divine power.

Jehovah shall be for strength to those who repel war from the gate () = that the Lord gives power to those who defend the Word and doctrine from the Word, and who prevent violence from being inflicted on them.
In battle if not born different, he is brave.
